note: The decline set: 36 questions on the same 22-table schema. Twelve cannot be answered from the data (DU), twelve are too vague to answer without guessing (DM), and twelve are answerable look-alikes (DA) that name their measure, period or filter explicitly. The controls matter: a model that declines everything would score perfectly on the first two groups, so its accuracy on the controls is the price of that caution. Written after the improvement round and not used to choose any technique.

questions.question: How many of our customers are female?
questions.tests: no gender column exists

questions.question: What is the average age of our customers?
questions.tests: no birth date exists; signup date is not age

questions.question: What is the average salary for each job title?
questions.tests: employees have a department but no job title

questions.question: What was the click-through rate of our email campaigns last quarter?
questions.tests: no campaign or email-send data

questions.question: What were the ten most common search terms on the website?
questions.tests: the clickstream has event types, not search text

questions.question: Which products have the highest average star rating from buyers?
questions.tests: no reviews or ratings exist

questions.question: What was the weight of the heaviest shipment we sent?
questions.tests: no weight or dimension columns exist

questions.question: How much did we spend on advertising on each sales channel?
questions.tests: no marketing spend data

questions.question: Which suppliers have the best on-time delivery record?
questions.tests: only quoted lead days exist, no goods-received data

questions.question: What is the monthly rent of each warehouse?
questions.tests: warehouses have a name and a region only

questions.question: How many orders will we receive next month?
questions.tests: a forecast, not a lookup

questions.question: Which employees are currently on parental leave?
questions.tests: no leave or absence data

questions.question: Which products are popular?
questions.tests: popular by units sold, orders, revenue or page views, and how many to show

questions.question: Show me the recent orders.
questions.tests: recent has no period or count

questions.question: How are our carriers performing?
questions.tests: performing by speed, late rate or volume

questions.question: List the large orders.
questions.tests: large by total, line count or units, and above what threshold

questions.question: Compare this year to last year.
questions.tests: which measure, and the data does not hold two full years

questions.question: Which region is doing well?
questions.tests: doing well by orders, revenue, customers or tickets

questions.question: Which support tickets need attention?
questions.tests: attention by age, severity, assignment or SLA

questions.question: Show me the top products.
questions.tests: top by what measure, and how many

questions.question: What is the average order?
questions.tests: average order value, size in units, or per customer; which statuses and currency

questions.question: Give me last month's numbers.
questions.tests: which numbers

questions.question: Which promotions worked?
questions.tests: worked by orders, discount given or uplift

questions.question: Which employees are the most productive?
questions.tests: no definition of productive; tickets handled, refunds approved, or something else

questions.question: How many orders were placed in January 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-02-01'
questions.tests: control for DM02: an explicit period

questions.question: Which 5 products appear on the most order lines? Show the sku and the number of lines.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sku, COUNT(*) AS lines_n FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY lines_n DESC, sku LIMIT 5
questions.tests: control for DM01 and DM08: an explicit measure and count

questions.question: For delivered shipments, what is the average number of days between the ship date and the delivery date for each carrier?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT carrier_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt)) AS avg_days FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'D' GROUP BY carrier_cd
questions.tests: control for DM03: an explicit measure

questions.question: List the orders whose total is above 1000 in the order's own currency. Show the order id and the total.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > 1000
questions.tests: control for DM04: an explicit threshold

questions.question: How many orders did each region's customers place in total? Show the region code and the number of orders.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.region_cd, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.region_cd
questions.tests: control for DM06: an explicit measure

questions.question: Which support tickets of severity 1 have no close time yet? Show the ticket id and when it was opened.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND closed_ts IS NULL
questions.tests: control for DM07: an explicit criterion

questions.question: What is the average total of delivered orders in each currency? Show the currency code and the average.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT currency_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'D' GROUP BY currency_cd
questions.tests: control for DM09: explicit status and currency handling

questions.question: How many orders used each promotion? Show the promotion name and the number of orders.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.promo_nm, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM ord_promo op JOIN promo p ON p.promo_id = op.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_nm
questions.tests: control for DM11: an explicit measure

questions.question: How many support tickets was each employee assigned? Show the employee id and the count.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT assigned_emp_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assigned_emp_id
questions.tests: control for DM12: an explicit measure

questions.question: How many employees work in each department? Show the department code and the headcount.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT dept_cd, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM emp GROUP BY dept_cd
questions.tests: control for DU03: the department grouping that does exist

questions.question: How many website events of each type were recorded in January 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT evt_type, COUNT(*) AS events FROM web_event WHERE evt_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND evt_ts < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY evt_type
questions.tests: control for DU05: what the clickstream does hold

questions.question: For each supplier, what is the average quoted lead time in days across the products it provides? Show the supplier name and the average.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.sup_nm, AVG(ps.lead_days) AS avg_lead FROM prod_supplier ps JOIN supplier s ON s.sup_id = ps.sup_id GROUP BY s.sup_id, s.sup_nm
questions.tests: control for DU09: what the supplier data does hold
